TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd confirms compliance with PITB’s requirements for the supply, installation, configuration and commissioning of enterprise network and data-centre infrastructure across six regional offices, including structured knowledge transfer and warranty support as specified.

Mandatory compliances evidenced: We hold valid ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certifications for information security management and quality management respectively [CO-PROFILE]. We are FBR registered and maintain Active Taxpayer (ATL) status [CO-PROFILE]. We have delivered multiple enterprise-scale network/data-centre engagements exceeding PKR 30 million within the last five years, including network design deployments valued at PKR 44M and PKR 182M [CAP-021][CAP-009]. We can furnish bid security equal to 2% of the quoted price via CDR/bank guarantee from a scheduled bank within our bank guarantee facility [CO-PROFILE]. We will submit the quotation with 90-day validity and in the required single sealed envelope format addressed to Director (Procurement), PITB, Arfa Software Technology Park, Lahore.

Technical/operational requirements: We will propose a redundant core design with no single point of failure supported by a documented high-availability implementation methodology.

Declared PARTIAL/GAP areas and closure plan:
- OEM engineer certifications (PARTIAL): Our library does not yet evidence OEM certifications for the specific engineers to be assigned; we will close this by assigning OEM-certified resources for the selected platform and providing their credentials prior to commissioning [CO-PROFILE].
- Centralised monitoring/management (PARTIAL): Our library does not yet evidence a specific NMS deployment; we will deliver centralised monitoring with alerting/reporting using the selected OEM’s management suite and/or an agreed platform during implementation.
- 24x7 helpdesk with 4-hour on-site response (PARTIAL): Our current evidenced SLAs are 24–48 hours [CO-PROFILE]; we will meet PITB’s 4-hour requirement by dedicating an incident desk and pre-positioned field engineers in-region under the warranty plan.
- Single OEM + valid partner/reseller authorisation (GAP, mandatory): Our library does not yet evidence current single-OEM authorisation; we will comply by proposing all active equipment from one OEM and submitting the required partner/reseller authorisation letter from that OEM before award/at contract finalisation, as directed by PITB.
